Overview

Leoben is a city in Styria with a population of 24,645. A historic mining town in Styria, home to the University of Leoben (mining and metallurgy), with a charming main square and the nearby Göss Abbey. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
